preprocessing.feature_order: 176 naturally sorted cell-voltage sensors followed by 32 naturally sorted temperature sensors
preprocessing.relative_transform: row sensor value minus same-row sensor-family mean

decision.window_rule: raw reconstruction-error argmin over five autoencoders
decision.file_rule: select the window with maximum normal-AE error, then apply raw argmin

limitations: Test05-Test09 real events and augmentations derived from them were used for training.
The reported Test01-Test09 metrics are internal replay results, not independent external validation.
Test04 produced 18 false-positive windows and Test05 normal segments produced 33 false-positive windows at stride 20.
Using stride 1 instead of the validated stride 20 changed the Test04 pack verdict to a false positive, so this candidate is restricted to stride 20.
Similarity values shown as fault confidence are not calibrated probabilities.
The composite-fault autoencoder plateaued early and remains structurally unstable.
